title: Re-qualify UI and panel feedback end to end
objective: Run fixture/scratch-only browser qualification for Results/SOW access, Day Setup prominence/access, CalendarImpact ignored-source filtering, local accounting override behavior, 24-hour times, regular task action controls, queue hierarchy, collapsed-state clarity, opaque More menus, tooltips, duration-memory visibility, and allocation overflow. Confirm FEEDBACK-01 through FEEDBACK-10 remain green. No live POST endpoints, no runtime mutation, no commit.

method.suites: Backend pytest from app/ (.venv); frontend vitest + tsc + vite builds from frontend/; bundles read back from rebuilt source.
method.browser: Rebuilt mockup (FixtureAdapter, __FIXTURE__) served GET-only on scratch 127.0.0.1:8790; driven by playwright-core 1.62.1 against cached chromium_headless_shell-1234; scenario per URL hash (#fresh/#sequenced/#commit-preview/#verified/#conflict); debug handle window.__tdtb used only to dispatch INPUTS_LOADED with an ignored/quarantined calendar row (display-only filter) and to toggle duration-memory overrides; console/pageerror/requestfailed/response>=400/non-GET collectors on every page; horizontal overflow measured on documentElement+body at 1280 and 390 widths.

residual_limitations: Accessibility audit is disabled by configuration (quality.a11y_audit_level=none); per config the a11y step was skipped entirely, so WCAG/axe-level claims are not made. Keyboard/tooltip/focus assertions above are behavioral browser checks, not an a11y audit.
Visual regression automation is disabled by configuration (quality.visual_regression_enabled=false); screenshots are evidence artifacts only, no baseline diff was performed.

Browser checks ran against the fixture mockup (FixtureAdapter) on scratch :8790, not the live runtime or real providers; ignored-source and duration-override states were seeded via the fixture debug handle (window.__tdtb) rather than a real calendar/todoist read.

One intermittent focus race was observed in dialog open: the useDialog focus-in effect can lag the dialog mount; checks wait for focus-in before Escape to model the real user. This is recorded honestly, not reported as a failure.
Keyboard reachability was measured by a reset-to-top Tab cycle; tab-cycle length is large in sequenced/verified states, so reachability was asserted via that cycle rather than raw tab index.

The rail clock readout retains 12-hour formatting ('7:22 AM') as a retained non-affected surface per FEEDBACK-09; 24-hour assertions were scoped to calendar impact, queue scheduled/dropped rows, and drawer exact-write times.
Backend count (1298) matches FEEDBACK-06; frontend count (567) matches FEEDBACK-10; suite growth across FEEDBACK-08/09/10 is reflected in the higher frontend total, not a regression.
